parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly states an action: "I suggest presenting these main experimental results in a more compact and coherent way instead of deferring most of them to the appendix." This is a direct suggestion. Moreover, the comment provides concrete details on how to apply this action: it names exactly which results are missing from the main text (the A-DDIM and PNDM baselines, and quantitative results on datasets other than CIFAR-10) and directs that these already-identified results be moved from the appendix into the main text. Thus the authors know precisely what to add and where to place it, which is concrete and directly implementable. Given the explicit action combined with these concrete implementation details, the comment fits the rubric level at which authors know exactly how to apply the suggested modification.
